question: What was the goal of 'National Beekeeping & Honey Mission' ('NBHM')?

options.text: To achieve the goal of the 'Black Revolution'
To achieve the goal of the 'Sweet Revolution'
To achieve the goal of the 'Red Revolution'
To achieve the goal of the 'Pink Revolution'

solution:
The Correct answer is __**To achieve the goal of the 'Sweet Revolution'**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **National Beekeeping & Honey Mission (NBHM)** was initiated to promote the development of scientific beekeeping in India.
 
• The primary objective of the NBHM is to achieve the goal of the **'Sweet Revolution'**, which aims to increase the production of **honey and related products**.
 
• The 'Sweet Revolution' is a government initiative launched to promote **apiculture** or beekeeping as part of a sustainable agricultural strategy.
 
• Beekeeping plays a vital role in increasing the **pollination efficiency** of crops, leading to higher yields and contributing to the growth of the **agriculture and horticulture sectors**.
 
• The mission provides financial assistance and technical guidance to farmers and beekeepers to enhance their **beekeeping practices**.
 
• It also emphasizes the production of quality honey and other bee-related products to meet **domestic and international market demand**.
 
• NBHM is implemented under the Ministry of **Agriculture and Farmers’ Welfare** in collaboration with the **National Bee Board (NBB)**.
 
• It promotes cross-sectoral collaboration for research and innovation in **honeybee health, breeding, and management**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **'Black Revolution'**__

 __
 
• The 'Black Revolution' refers to the efforts aimed at increasing the production of **petroleum and related products**.
 
• It focuses on reducing the dependency on **imported crude oil** through indigenous production strategies.
 
 
 
• **'Red Revolution'**__
 __
 
• The 'Red Revolution' is associated with the increase in the production of **meat and tomato**.
 
• It is focused on enhancing **food security** and improving **nutrition levels**.
 
 
 
• **'Pink Revolution'**__
 
 
• The 'Pink Revolution' is related to the growth in the production of **poultry and shrimp**.
 
• This initiative aims to boost the **livelihoods of farmers** and meet the rising demand for **poultry products**.
